message.content:
Replaced the default-construct-then-copy-assign body with direct member initialization. This avoids `std::vector` copy-assignment overhead and lets each vector copy-construct directly, which is faster for the many small/empty field vectors.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values), stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
